Crab Meat Mornay with Rice Pilaf, fresh local crab prepared with delicious Mornay sauce and served with rice pilaf.
Deep Fried Crab Legs*, Specially breaded, then deep fried to golden brown crispness and served with tartar sauce. Served with Potatoes du Jour.

Crab Legs Saute, fresh local crab. Served on a bed of rice pilaf
HALIBUT FLORENTINE.....A popular fish served on a bed of tender young spinach and covered with smooth Mornay sauce.
CRAB MEAT NEWBURG WITH RICE PILAF...Large, tender chunks of local crab meat in the Chef's special sauce. Served in a different way with rice pilaf.
GRILLED FILET OF HALIBUT STEAK*.....A delicious white fish, carefully grilled and served with tart lemon butter. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
POACHED SALMON STEAK WITH EGG SAUCE.....A richly flavored fish served with a creamy sauce. Boiled potatoes.
DEVILED CRAB.....Our Pacific crab meat is combined with a saucy mixture of tangy herbs and baked in coastal sea shell with rice pilaf.
BROILED KING SALMON STEAK*.....Choice red salmon broiled quickly to preserve its tenderness. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
FRIED EASTERN OYSTERS*.....Tender and juicy, these oysters are deep fried and served piping hot. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
PAN FRIED BONED RAINBOW TROUT*.....As good tasting as any you've ever cooked over the campfire. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
HANGTOWN FRIED OYSTERS*.....This is a real treat. Tender oysters fried in butter and mixed into a fluffy egg omelet. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
STEAMED FINNAN HADDIE.....Always a favorite the world over. Boiled potatoes.
BAKED OYSTERS (Kirkpatrick or Rockefeller)*..Large Eastern oysters, baked and served on the half shell. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
BAKED SEA BASS*.....A rich and flavorful fish served with delicate Bercy sauce. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
BROILED WHOLE CALIFORNIA LOBSTER*....The delicate flavor of California lobster reaches the peak of perfection with tangy lemon butter sauce. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
PAN BROILED SEA BASS STEAK*.....Quickly broiled and tasty. One of the ocean's finest. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
FILET OF SEA BASS DORE MEUNIERE*.....Carefully prepared and served with drawn parsley butter. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
LOBSTER THERMIDOR*.....A superlative dish that will not be forgotten. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
STEAMED ALASKA COD.....Prepared by steaming to seal in its delicate flavor. Served with boiled potato.
LOBSTER TAILS SAUTE NEWBURG.....Large tails of lobster prepared in a special cream sauce and served with exotic rice pilaf.
BROILED SWORDFISH STEAK*.....A rich succulent fish, guaranteed to satisy the most exacting diner. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
DEEP FRIED JUMBO PRAWNS*.....These are the choice prawns of the Gulf waters. Served with tangy tartar sauce. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
BAKED STUFFED TURBOT.....A taste-exciting white fish stuffed with shell fish meat seasoned with a rare herb sauce and Parisian potatoes.
CURRIED LOUISIANA PRAWNS A L'INDIENNE..This skillfully seasoned dish is something different and out of the ordinary. With rice pilaf.
PAN BROILED HAWAIIAN MAHI, MAHI*.....For an exotic sea food treat reminiscent of the Islands, try this Hawaiian favorite. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
SHRIMP CREOL WITH RICE PILAF.....The delictable flavor of this old Sother delight i brought to San Francisco's Bayside.
BOUILLABAISE A LA MARSEILLAISE.....Prepared from our Chef's authentic continental recipe. French gourmets acclaim this delectable sea food.
ABALONE STEAK*.....This tender Monterey abalone is a real treat; its delicate flavor is artfully enhanced by tangy lemon butter and tartar sauce. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
COMBINATION SEA FOOD NEWBURG.....Unusual casserole prepared with our Chef's private recipe. Served with rice pilaf.
DEEP FRIED SCALLOPS*.....Breaded and deep fried to a crisp golden brown. Served with tartar sauce. Also comes with Potatoes du Jour.
COMBINATION SEA FOOD PLATE, DEEP FRIED*...For those who find it difficult to choose among the sea food delicacies. Served with Potatoes du Jour.
SCALLOPS AU GRATIN.....Eastern scallops with fresh mushrooms, chooped white onions, white wine, baked in casserole, au gratin, served with rice pilaf.

Louis M. Martini Mountain Folle Blanche, 1954 Vintage - The American equivalent of a fine Chablis. Clean, well-made, very dry, and an excellent bouquet.

Beaulieu Vineyard Dry Sauternes - Semillon, principally used in the production of this wine, and Sauvignon Blanc are the two celebrated grape varieties for quality and finesse. Soft, pleasantly dry. Served chilled.
Beaulieu Vineyard Beauclair - Produced exclusively from Johannisberg Riesling grapes grown in the Beaulieu Vineyard. This grape is the aristocrat of the finest Rhines and Moselles of Germany. Pale greenish gold with distinctive fruitiness and flavor.
Beaulieu Vinyard Beauclair (continued) - An outstanding Johannisberg Riesling. Serve chilled. These wines are produced exclusively from grapes grown in the Beaulieu Vineyard, Rutherford, Napa Valley, California.

Nathaniel Johnston & Fils Graves 1953

Imperial Grandjo 1953 - The surging popularity of this Portuguese white comes from much more than its inviting price. No other wine so charmingly combines qualities of Graves and Sauterne while still having its own unique bouquet and flavor.

Calvert French Wine: Lion D'Or 1952 - A Bordeaux white, fairly dry, pleasantly fruity wine.

Soup of the Evening
Roast Long Island Duckling.  Roasted crisp and served with a sauce made with apricot brandy and glazed apricots.  Accompanied by nutted brown rice.
Melange of Seafood in Pasta. Jumbo shrimp, bay scallops, little neck clams, mussels and water chestnuts in a cream sauce with fresh dill.  Served on a bed of spinach tagliatella
Escalope of Veal a la Viennoise.  Thinly sliced veal lightly breaded with fresh bread crumbs then sauteed in brown butter, topped with chopped eggs, minced parsley and capers.  Served with zucchini.
Washington State Salmon.  Filet of salmon sauteed in clarified butter, then simmered in white wine, shallots, tomatoes and fresh basil.  Accompanied by parslied potatoes.
Breast of Chicken, Diable.  A grilled breast of chicken breaded in fresh bread crumbs, dijon mustard and parsley, then baked in the oven till golden brown.  Served with a sauce of white wine reduced with shallots and chicken stock blended with mustard.  Croquette potatoes.
Rack of Lamb Persillee.  Young rack of lamb roasted with robust herbs and a blend of finely chopped parsley and rosemary.  Accompanied by string beans au gratin
CHEF'S SPECIAL SELECTION OF THE EVENING-Steak au Poivre. A sirloin steak rolled in freshly cracked green, black and white peppercorns and sauteed. A sauce made with the juices of the sirloin blended with brandy, beef stock and cream is placed over the steak. Served with Rissole potatoes and tomato provencale.
